Beacon scope

What the app does now

  • Connects MetaMask and injected wallets to peaq Mainnet.
  • Opens presale, staking, exchange, vesting, support and node activation pages.
  • Installs as a PWA with offline shell caching.
  • Provides a truthful launch path before native signing budgets exist.
Security policy

No seed phrase custody

PHN Beacon is not a custodial wallet. It never asks for private keys or seed phrases. Wallet actions remain inside MetaMask, Binance Wallet, WalletConnect-compatible wallets, or the future PHN wallet after a formal security review.
